title: Fully Local LLM Sandbox: A tiny assistant with an attitude
author: FranciscoCarlosErra
selftext:
Meet a tiny robot with a big attitude. Hold a button, tell her "build me a tower", and she does: blind, never seen a thing, absolutely sure she just made a masterpiece. Wrong height, wrong place, zero doubt, plenty of sass. 

It lives entirely on your own machine: local model, local ears, local voice, no cloud. Come argue with her.

[https://github.com/franciscocarloserra/llm-sandbox/](https://github.com/franciscocarloserra/llm-sandbox/)

replies.author: FranciscoCarlosErra
replies.body: Claude build me the flattest level ever, maek no mistakes

comments.author: waypostmaster
comments.body: This sounds awesome. Do you think i could port them into frontiervalley.fyi ?

replies.author: FranciscoCarlosErra
replies.body: Go for it, man! Inference scales well locally, but would could get costly as a service

comments.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
comments.body: You could make this a little more engaging by adding something where you need to do specific tasks to get "tokens" for the AI assistant to make things. That would tie in with how AI actually generates stuff while also providing a more interesting gameplay loop. Maybe by breaking objects you can get a certain amount of tokens per "block". Similar to how resources work in minecraft

replies.author: FranciscoCarlosErra
replies.body: Absolutely, there eventually should be a goal, just an interaction proof of concept as is, it's fun to see it fail and misinterpret you in a low-stakes environment, feel free to try it out locally if you have the VRAM for it

replies.author: IsThisASnakeInMyBoot
replies.body: was going to try it out, but I don't have python, don't know how or where to get 3 local models, and I only have 8GB of VRAM. Crazy to think that I can run Elden Ring on this laptop but wouldn't be able to run this lmao

replies.author: FranciscoCarlosErra
replies.body: LMAO yeah, I expect the whole stack to just run fine on a phone soon, but on the mean time it's a pain to install, either codex or claude should one-shot the install but yeah the PoC itself is probably not worth it as is.
